payload.body: Released features leave the horizon shelves: the roadmap product view renders a derived trailing released bucket (released-stage features exit their now/next/later groups automatically), the brief's roadmap block applies the same exclusion, and a new validate warning roadmap.horizon-stale flags a feature whose work has started (dev in-flight or built, stage not released) while its horizon still reads next/later — fix hint: move it to now. Horizon stays human-set intent for unshipped work; no stored status is added. Decided with Jim in chat 2026-08-17 from handoff roadmap-horizon-vs-stage.
